mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlists ( id, user_id, name, mood_tag, is_public ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{moodTag}, #{isPublic} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, mood_tag, is_public, created_at FROM playlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, name, mood_tag, is_public, created_at FROM playlists WHERE id = #{playlistId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ps.id, ps.playlist_id, ps.song_id, s.title, s.artist, s.genre, s.era, s.youtube_url, s.youtube_id, ps.order_num, ps.added_at FROM playlist_songs ps JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id WHERE ps.playlist_id = #{playlistId} ORDER BY ps.order_num ASC, ps.added_at ASC
